[[Karleen]] is a [[collector]] located in [[The Catacombs]].

== Locations ==
* [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)]]
** {{NPC location|The Catacombs}} (near the [[portal]] to [[Green Hills County]], not during [[Charr in the Catacombs]] nor [[The Power of Blood]])

== Dialogue ==
: ''"I'm searching for 5 [[Gargoyle Skull]]s. I can offer one of the following items in exchange. Can you help me?"''

== Collector items ==
{{:Karleen/Collector armor}}

== Notes ==

She can easily be reached coming from [[Barradin's Estate]] and heading north toward the entrance to The Catacombs in [[Green Hills County]]. However, due to the initial [[loot scaling]] when entering the map, it is easier to get the items she wants coming from [[Ashford Abbey]] and killing all gargoyles along the way.
